laws.name: Arizona Fair Wages and Healthy Families Act (Earned Paid Sick Time)
laws.description: Provides paid sick time for employees in Arizona for medical needs, family care, public health emergencies, and issues related to domestic violence, sexual violence, or stalking.

laws.name: Arizona School Activity Leave (Public Employees)
laws.description: Allows state employees to use paid leave to attend school conferences or classroom activities for their children.
